test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

Rajat said, “I submitted my work assignment yesterday.”

options.text: Rajat said that he had submitted his work assignment yesterday.
Rajat said that he have submitted his work assignment the previous day.
Rajat said that he had submitted his work assignment the previous day.
Rajat said that he submitted his work assignment yesterday.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Rajat said that he had submitted his work assignment the previous day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in direct speech and we need to convert it to indirect speech.
 
• When we change a direct speech to an indirect speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reporting verb "said" remains unchanged in the indirect speech.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") are replaced with the conjunction 'that' to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is removed in the indirect speech.
 
• The first word of the indirect speech should be in capital letters.
 
• The first person pronoun "**I**" changes to the third person pronoun "**He**" in the reported speech.
 
• "**My**" changes to "**His**" in the reported speech.
 
• If the direct speech is written in the **simple past** tense, it will be changed into the **past perfect** tense in the indirect speech.
 
• "**Yesterday**" in the direct speech changes to "**the previous day**" in the indirect speech.
 
 
 
• Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.

 

Hence, indirect speech is - *Rajat said that he had submitted his work assignment the previous day.*
